'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Joe Young DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Young]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Joseph Young
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
